events.title: Farmer's Diary - Devlog #1: Welcome to the Ranch
events.summary: Devlog #1: Welcome to the Ranch As we get closer to our demo release, we wanted to share how Farmer's Diary works and what we had in mind while building it. The StoryYou leave your job in the city and come back to your father's ranch. He left you the land and the diary he kept, along with some unpaid bills. The ranch hasn't run properly in years.
